dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent and sharp pale-white borders are visible along the outer edges of the dark folded primary and secondary feathers, creating a distinct repetitive lined boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high-contrast scalloped effect across the entire upper-body plumage, resulting from broad, pale-grey fringes on dark-centered feathers.
